hypotheses.label: Exoplanet transit
hypotheses.description: A planet periodically crosses its host star and causes repeatable, shallow decreases in observed brightness.

hypotheses.label: Stellar flare
hypotheses.description: Magnetic reconnection on a star produces a rapid asymmetric brightening followed by slower cooling.

hypotheses.label: Gravitational microlensing
hypotheses.description: A foreground mass gravitationally magnifies a background star in an approximately symmetric nonrepeating event.

hypotheses.label: Pulsar timing anomaly
hypotheses.description: Unexpected residuals in highly regular radio-pulse arrival times indicate a glitch, companion, or propagation effect.

hypotheses.label: Fast radio burst
hypotheses.description: A millisecond-duration extragalactic radio transient arrives with frequency-dependent dispersion.

hypotheses.label: Supernova light curve
hypotheses.description: A stellar explosion produces a strong luminosity rise and a multiweek decline powered by expansion or radioactive decay.

hypotheses.label: Cepheid variable star
hypotheses.description: A pulsating star follows a period-luminosity relation that enables extragalactic distance measurement.

hypotheses.label: Black-hole accretion variability
hypotheses.description: Hot plasma in an accretion disk and corona around a black hole produces variable X-ray emission.

hypotheses.label: Gravitational-wave chirp
hypotheses.description: A compact binary inspiral emits a waveform whose frequency and amplitude rise before merger.

hypotheses.label: Galaxy redshift
hypotheses.description: The displacement of galaxy spectral lines toward longer wavelengths estimates recession and cosmic distance.

hypotheses.label: Weak lensing by dark matter
hypotheses.description: Coherent distortions in background-galaxy shapes trace otherwise invisible foreground mass.

hypotheses.label: Cosmic microwave background anisotropy
hypotheses.description: Small temperature and polarization fluctuations in relic microwave radiation constrain early-universe physics.

hypotheses.label: Solar coronal mass ejection
hypotheses.description: The Sun ejects a magnetized plasma cloud that can drive geomagnetic disturbances near Earth.

hypotheses.label: Asteroid occultation
hypotheses.description: A small Solar-System body briefly blocks a background star along a narrow path on Earth.

hypotheses.label: Tidal disruption event
hypotheses.description: A star passing close to a massive black hole is torn apart and creates a luminous nuclear flare.

hypotheses.label: Neutron-star merger kilonova
hypotheses.description: Two neutron stars merge, producing gravitational waves, a short gamma-ray burst, and r-process optical emission.

hypotheses.label: Quasar variability
hypotheses.description: An active galactic nucleus changes brightness stochastically as its accretion flow evolves.

hypotheses.label: Brown-dwarf atmosphere
hypotheses.description: Spectra and rotational variability of a cool substellar object reveal molecular absorption and patchy clouds.

hypotheses.label: Protoplanetary disk structure
hypotheses.description: Dust and gas around a young star form rings, gaps, and spirals associated with planet formation.

hypotheses.label: Baryon acoustic oscillation
hypotheses.description: A preferred comoving separation in galaxy clustering provides a cosmological standard ruler.
